{{Quote|Admiral Bwua'tu knows what an inspiration he is for the crew of the Admiral Ackbar. They feel privileged to serve under an admiral who has risen from the obscurity of a birth on Ruweln to become the finest fleet commander the Galactic Alliance has ever seen|[[Wurf'al]]|<ref name="UQ" />}}
'''Ruweln''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony world<ref name="CE" /> located in [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ruweln was among the roughly 150 settled [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in Bothan Space dominated by Bothan [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], and was ruled by the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]], which was made up of representatives from hundreds of [[Clan|Bothan clans]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]].<ref name="UQ" />
